title: ¿Cómo funcionan los puntos de sutura? 😯
engine_reason: Organic skin/tissue transformation and camera travel -> t2v (rule a). Scene 2 is contact mechanics and would take the keyframes override, but that route is DISABLED (spike R2 failed), so it stays t2v with a strengthened prompt (single needle shape, explicit never-clauses).
hook_question: ¿Por qué los puntos de sutura cierran una herida que no se cierra sola?
false_belief: Que una herida profunda se cierra sola si la dejas quieta.
closing_reframe: Un punto de sutura no cierra la herida: la mantiene unida mientras tu cuerpo hace el trabajo.
share_archetype: ese amigo que se corta cocinando y dice que no necesita puntos
style: Bright stylized 3D cartoon animation, Pixar-style explainer short, smooth clean materials, soft studio lighting. Strictly NOT photorealistic: no realistic textures, no real faces, no blood, no gore, no graphic content. No text on screen. Medical illustration look. Show the body as clean stylized cross-section models.
audio_style: Audio: foley sound effects matching the action only, no music, no voices, no narration.

audio.music_credit: Sneaky Snitch by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 3.0

scenes.name: hook
scenes.prompt: A smooth cartoon forearm model on a clean pastel background. A simple cut opens along the forearm: two rounded skin edges slowly drift apart, leaving a clean flat-colored gap between them. Never realistic skin, never blood, never a bleeding or torn wound.
scenes.transformation: forearm with intact smooth skin → forearm with a clean open gap between two rounded skin edges
scenes.camera: starts wide on the whole forearm, then travels slowly along its length toward the cut
scenes.narration: ¿Cómo funcionan los puntos de sutura? Cuando el corte es profundo, los bordes de la piel quedan demasiado lejos para cerrar solos.

scenes.name: curved-needle
scenes.prompt: One single stylized curved surgical needle with black thread, always the same smooth curved shape, pierces the skin surface just beside the left edge of a stylized cut, travels under the gap inside the skin, and exits the skin surface just beside the right edge. The thread follows the needle and then tightens, pulling both edges together into one neat zigzag stitch. Never the needle poking into the open gap, never a straight needle, never a hook, never two needles, never a changing needle shape, never blood.
scenes.transformation: needle above the left edge of the open cut → needle through both edges with the thread pulled tight and the edges together
scenes.camera: orbits slowly around the cut at a low three-quarter angle, keeping the needle in frame
scenes.narration: Por eso el médico usa una aguja curva: su forma permite coser sin desgarrar más tejido. El hilo acerca los bordes y los mantiene unidos, porque una herida cerrada sana más rápido y deja menos cicatriz.

scenes.name: knots
scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of a cartoon black thread lying across a closed stylized skin cut. Two thread ends loop around each other and pull tight into one small neat knot sitting on top of the skin, then the next knot forms beside it. Never a tangled mess, never loose threads flying around, no blood.
scenes.transformation: loose thread ends crossing over the closed cut → small neat knots sitting on the skin
scenes.camera: tracks slowly along the line of the cut as the knots form one after another
scenes.narration: Cada punto se asegura con nudos diminutos, para que nada se suelte.

scenes.name: absorbable
scenes.prompt: A clean cartoon cross-section cutaway of skin drawn as flat pastel color layers. A small thread loop sitting inside the layers slowly fades and shrinks until it disappears completely, while the layers stay whole and intact. Never the skin breaking open, never organs or real tissue textures, no blood.
scenes.transformation: thread loop intact inside the skin layers → thread completely dissolved, layers still intact
scenes.camera: travels slowly down through the cross-section from the top skin layer to the deepest layer
scenes.narration: Algunos hilos son absorbibles y tu cuerpo los disuelve solos: esos nunca hay que sacarlos.

scenes.name: risk
scenes.prompt: Cartoon healed skin with a row of small stitches. The smooth skin slowly grows up and over the thread of one stitch, then cartoon tweezers enter from the top right, grip that stitch and gently lift it out of the skin. Never pulling the skin apart, never reopening the cut, no blood.
scenes.transformation: row of stitches resting on healed skin → skin grown over one stitch, then that stitch lifted out
scenes.camera: pushes in while orbiting a quarter turn around the row of stitches
scenes.narration: Pero si dejas los normales demasiado tiempo, la piel crece sobre el hilo y retirarlos se vuelve un problema.

scenes.name: ant-twist
scenes.prompt: A big friendly stylized cartoon ant stands beside a small closed cartoon skin cut, bites both edges with its jaws so they pinch together like a staple, against a softly blurred green jungle background. Never a swarm of ants, never a photorealistic insect close-up, no blood.
scenes.transformation: ant standing beside a closed cut → ant biting both edges so they pinch together
scenes.camera: starts in a macro shot of the ant's jaws, then pulls back and up to reveal the jungle background
scenes.narration: Y el dato más loco: durante siglos se usaron hormigas vivas como puntos, porque al morder cerraban la herida con sus mandíbulas.
